label: Effective resolution
help: Manufacturer effective photosites; may differ from saved image dimensions.

label: Full-size image width
help: Single-shot, uncropped still image; excludes pixel-shift composites.

label: Full-size image height
help: Single-shot, uncropped still image.

label: Sensor width
help: Physical imaging sensor width, not the nominal format name.

label: Sensor height
help: Physical imaging sensor height.

label: Sensor technology
help: For example CMOS, BSI CMOS, stacked CMOS, or CCD.

label: Color filter array
help: For example Bayer or X-Trans; relevant to RAW processing.

label: Lens mount
help: Lens compatibility; adapters may impose restrictions.

label: Minimum standard ISO
help: Standard still-photo range; not a recommended astrophotography ISO.

label: Maximum standard ISO
help: A higher maximum does not prove better low-light performance.

label: Minimum expanded ISO
help: May be digitally derived; not equivalent to native sensitivity.

label: Maximum expanded ISO
help: May be digitally derived; not a quality score.

label: RAW capture
help: RAW preserves more processing flexibility than JPEG.

label: RAW bit depths
help: Available depths; actual depth can depend on shooting mode.

label: RAW compression and restrictions
help: Lossless, lossy, uncompressed, and mode-specific limitations.

label: Bulb exposure
help: Long exposure capability; remote release may be required.

label: Longest timed exposure
help: Regular timed still exposure; excludes Bulb and special extended modes.

label: Exposure mode restrictions
help: Firmware, shutter type, or menu settings may change exposure limits.

label: Built-in interval timer
help: Useful for unattended sequences; exposure limits still apply.

label: Long-exposure noise reduction
help: May add a dark-frame exposure and interrupt a sequence.

label: Live view
help: Useful for composition and manual star focusing.

label: Focus magnification
help: Available manual-focus magnification and restrictions.

label: In-body stabilization
help: Tripod behavior depends on model and setup; not a substitute for sky tracking.

label: Optical low-pass filter
help: Filter design can affect fine detail and aliasing.

label: Factory astronomy filter
help: Factory spectral modifications; user modifications belong to the equipment profile.

label: Operating temperature range
help: Manufacturer operating conditions; does not quantify thermal noise.

label: External power options
help: USB power, DC coupler, and accessory requirements.

label: Remote release options
help: Wired, wireless, or computer triggering; compatibility must be checked.

label: Read noise measurements
help: Requires independent calibrated measurements by ISO, RAW mode, and temperature.

label: Dynamic range measurements
help: Requires a documented measurement method and ISO-specific results.

label: Quantum efficiency measurements
help: Wavelength-dependent photon conversion; cannot be inferred from megapixels.

label: Dark current measurements
help: Requires exposure time, temperature, and calibrated measurement conditions.

label: Full-well measurements
help: Requires documented units, gain, and measurement method.

label: RAW processing behavior
help: Documented spatial filtering, hot-pixel suppression, or long-exposure artifacts.
